items.title: Bitcoin slips 1% but above $80,000 as ETF inflows revive institutional demand
items.summary: Investing.com -- Bitcoin Bitcoin slipped 1% to $80,794 on Sunday, giving back some of its weekend gains as broader cryptocurrency markets turned lower despite renewed institutional demand through U.S. spot Bitcoin exchange-traded funds.

items.title: TotalEnergies (ENXTPA:TTE) Ties Up $1.8 Billion For African Infrastructure
items.summary: TotalEnergies (ENXTPA:TTE) agreed a $1.8b infrastructure partnership with Global Infrastructure Partners, a BlackRock unit, focused on African oil and gas assets. The transaction centers on midstream infrastructure, giving TotalEnergies additional access to capital tied to its African energy projects. items.title: Could Circle Internet Group (CRCL) Become A Bigger Force In Onchain Finance?
items.summary: Circle Internet Group (NYSE:CRCL) launched Arc, a purpose-built open Layer 1 blockchain for financial markets, as its public mainnet. Arc integrates Circle's USDC and EURC stablecoins for payments, FX, trading, lending, and asset issuance with dollar-denominated gas fees. The network is backed by an institutional validator set that includes BlackRock, DTCC, Mastercard, Visa, and other financial players.
